title: Token limit exceeded error

userPrompts.text: In another project I got: 223 x 24 CHAT @SESSION-CONTROL /ANALYZE Start Over @session-control /analyze session-control Analysis failed before a report could be saved. Analysis failed: Message exceeds token limit.
also make it skip session-control /analze chats
now I get: session-control Analysis failed before a report could be saved. Analysis failed: The saved session exceeds the model token limit even when analyzed on its own.
